source.description: Git source as `npx skills add` takes it: `owner/repo` or a git URL.

skills.description:
Skills to install. Empty: every skill of the pack that is not
installed yet, which needs git access to list them.

ref_pin.description: Branch, tag, or commit to pin the pack to.

harnesses.description:
Agents to link, in the `skills` CLI's `--agent` spelling. Every skill
also gets the shared `.agents/skills` copy that update and remove use.
Empty: the shared copy only.

project_path.description: Install into this tracked project. Absent: the home.

dry_run.description: Return the plan and change nothing.

AgentIdentity.description:
Kebab-case harness identifier, for example `claude-code` or `opencode`.

Legacy spellings are normalized at input boundaries.
